annotations.title: Read a minute of an episode

description: About a minute of an episode's transcript, from a second into the video, for an episode Real Alpha cut: the lines with their times and, where the transcript says, who is talking, plus the link that plays the episode from there. Use it to check the exact words around a moment's quote (a moment's `episode_url` has the video id and second). Only the episodes Real Alpha cut have a transcript, never more than about a minute of one at a time, and a machine transcript can misspell names.

video.description: The YouTube video id, like "dQw4w9WgXcQ", or a realalpha.app/v/ or YouTube link

name: transcript_excerpt

date.description: When the episode came out, YYYY-MM-DD

moment.description: The moment the second falls in, if any

url.description: The episode playing from that second
